mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate above 4.5% signal dual stress from monetary tightening and labor market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing market weakness (HOUST below 1400 thousand units for 3 consecutive months) signals declining consumer spending, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as policy easing expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has been below 1400 for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has risen for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces aggregate demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has been below 1400 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate central bank intervention.
failure_condition: The interaction of declining HOUST and declining INDPRO fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100 for 3 consecutive months) signals manufacturing contraction that increases recession risks, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has been below 100 for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
